annotation.title_clean: OSH and the Future of Work: benefits and risks of artificial intelligence tools in workplaces
annotation.title_en: OSH and the Future of Work: benefits and risks of artificial intelligence tools in workplaces
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Agency for Safety and Health at Work (EU-OSHA)
annotation.summary_en: EU-OSHA publication landing page for a 2019 discussion paper on how AI and big data affect occupational safety and health. It gives workplace examples, including people analytics, AI-augmented robotics, chatbots and wearables, and discusses the consequences of poor implementation and the conditions for good implementation.
key_provisions_or_claims: Digital developments will significantly change work and affect wellbeing, safety and health.
Examples of AI in workplaces include people analytics, recruitment, AI-augmented robotics, chatbots and wearables.
Poor implementation of AI technology can have negative OSH consequences.
The paper discusses the conditions needed for good implementation.
